_note: Sample parts. Mass, power and cost are approximate game-balance placeholders, not vendor figures. powerW: negative consumes, positive produces. icon is a Tabler icon component name.

items.name: Ice Drill + Spectrometer
items.description: One-metre drill with an onboard spectrometer to confirm water ice in shadowed regolith.

items.name: Deployable Solar Array (5 kW)
items.description: Fold-out array rated at Earth-orbit sunlight. Output scales with the destination's sunlight factor and drops when dusty.

items.name: Lithium Battery Pack (20 kWh)
items.description: Stores daytime power for the long, cold lunar night.

items.name: High-Gain Antenna
items.description: Narrow-beam dish for high data rates. Must be pointed precisely at Earth.

items.name: Life Support Core (ECLSS)
items.description: Air revitalisation, water recovery and temperature control for a crew of four.

items.name: Surface EVA Suit
items.description: Pressurised suit for surface work. One suit supports one crew member outside at a time.

items.name: Critical Spares Kit
items.description: Fuses, pumps, seals and connectors for the three most likely failures.

items.name: Unpressurised Mini Rover
items.description: Two-seat rover that extends the reachable science sites beyond walking distance.
